THERMALVORTEX_CARDPILE_EXTRA_DECK.title: Extra Deck
THERMALVORTEX_CARDPILE_EXTRA_DECK.descri: Click to view your complete owned Extra Deck.
THERMALVORTEX_CARDPILE_EXTRA_DECK.combat: Click to view your complete owned Extra Deck. {Remaining}/{Owned} cards remain this combat.
THERMALVORTEX_CARDPILE_EXTRA_DECK.screen: Your complete owned Extra Deck, with each copy showing its actual upgrade state and a Used or Unused label beneath it.
THERMALVORTEX_CARDPILE_REWARD_POOL.title: Reward Pool
THERMALVORTEX_CARDPILE_REWARD_POOL.descr: Click to view possible rewards for this run: {Main} main-card types and {Extra} Extra Deck card types.
THERMALVORTEX_CARDPILE_REWARD_POOL.scree: Possible rewards for this run: {Main} main-card types followed by {Extra} Extra Deck card types. These cards must still be acquired during the adventure. The five fixed main cards and starting Extra Deck card Detonation are not shown because they never appear as rewards.
THERMALVORTEX_DEVOUR_STATUS.title: Devour Status
THERMALVORTEX_DEVOUR_STATUS.enemyDrawAny: Draw 1 card whenever an enemy resolves 1 attack hit or 1 other action effect
THERMALVORTEX_DEVOUR_STATUS.enemyDrawAtt: Draw 1 card whenever an enemy attacks; each hit of a multi-hit attack triggers separately
THERMALVORTEX_DEVOUR_STATUS.enemyDrawPow: Draw 1 card whenever an enemy buffs itself or another enemy, applies a debuff to you, or adds a Status card to your piles; each qualifying effect in the same action triggers separately
THERMALVORTEX_DEVOUR_STATUS.enemyDrawSum: Draw 1 card for each enemy summoned
THERMALVORTEX_DEVOUR_STATUS.infinityEffe: At turn start, use inherited attack against a random enemy; at turn end, randomly Devour 1 other monster on your field
THERMALVORTEX_DEVOUR_STATUS.upkeepBlock: Starting next turn, gain {Amount} Block at turn start
THERMALVORTEX_DEVOUR_STATUS.upkeepWeakAl: Apply {Amount} Weak to all enemies at turn start
THERMALVORTEX_DEVOUR_STATUS.upkeepVulner: Apply {Amount} Vulnerable to all enemies at turn start
THERMALVORTEX_DEVOUR_STATUS.materialDama: When used as Material, choose 1 enemy and deal {Amount} damage
THERMALVORTEX_DEVOUR_STATUS.faraEffect: Cannot be targeted by enemy attacks; Special Summon this monster again after being used as Material
THERMALVORTEX_DEVOUR_STATUS.contractBook: At turn start, gain 2 Energy and draw {DrawReduction} fewer cards normally; each inherited copy stacks and retains its source's upgraded draw reduction
THERMALVORTEX_DEVOUR_STATUS.pieceControl: When Summoned, Sift {Amount}; preserve existing Draw order and shuffle the Discard pile below it if needed
THERMALVORTEX_DEVOUR_STATUS.pieceHeal: When Summoned, heal the player for {Amount} HP
THERMALVORTEX_DEVOUR_STATUS.pieceFusion: While fielded, whenever a friendly monster is Summoned, you may Fuse using hand and field materials. Once per event; each new Summon can trigger again
